preconditions.description: The input phone must be a string.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'In with a chance' if (cleaned := phone.replace('-', '')) and ((cleaned.startswith('07') and len(cleaned) == 11 and cleaned[2:].isdigit()) or (cleaned.startswith('+44') and len(cleaned) == 12 and cleaned[3:].isdigit())) else 'Plenty more fish in the sea'
postconditions.description: Returns 'In with a chance' if the string, after removing all dashes, is non-empty and matches either the UK domestic format (starts with '07' followed by 9 digits) or the international format (starts with '+44' followed by 10 digits). Otherwise, returns 'Plenty more fish in the sea'.
